Grit matlab apna waada nibhana.
Shant samundar ne skilled sailor nahi banaya.
Grit andar ki aag hai.
Khamoshi better questions bulaati hai.
Himmat aage badhne ki taakat hona nahi, balki taakat na hone par bhi aage badhna hai.
Duniya me kuch bhi worth nahi—jab tak woh effort, pain, difficulty na maange.
Success final nahi, failure fatal nahi—continue ka courage matter karta hai.
Chunauti mein himmat dhoondo.
Saahas hi sab gunon ki buniyad hai.
Grit ka matlab hai lambi muddat ke lakshya ke liye jazba aur lagan.
Grit sapnon ko plans banata.
Quiet logon ke paas sabse loud minds hote hain.
Real test of courage yeh hai ki kya tum defeat endure kar sakte ho.
Patience wait karne ki ability nahi—wait ke dauran bhi achha attitude banaye rakhne ki ability hai.
Grit har baar talent ko haraati hai.
Courage contagious hota hai.
Himmat ek kadam se shuru hoti hai.
Khamoshi bhaag hai.
